capabilities: Scan Codex sessions and reduce them into a project-wide review without Agent calls or token usage
Synchronize editable project review files into the vault via a deterministic three-way merge
Browse and edit project evolution, decisions, risks, and usage in a desktop project view
Prepare bounded evidence packets for optional Agent-assisted semantic review via a skill
Optionally read OpenCode session databases through a read-only SQLite adapter
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition or note-review tool; it reviews coding-agent session history and produces project summary notes.
extras: Desktop-only plugin that invokes a local Go-built CLI with allow-listed actions; explicitly requires no OpenAI API key; the OpenCode adapter is a development candidate pinned to OpenCode 1.18.30; release assets ship with SHA256 checksums.
problem: Recovering a project's context from coding-agent session logs means reading raw JSONL transcripts by hand or copying them into notes.

relations.evidence: SessionReviewer turns local Codex session history into a concise, editable project review.
The read-only SQLite adapter is opt-in. Set SESSION_REVIEWER_OPENCODE_DB to an absolute path

summary: Turns local Codex CLI session history into an editable project review covering goals, evolution, decisions, risks, usage, and cost.
